lede: Miami (OH) carries the stronger underlying team rating — -2.3 against -7.5, a 5.2-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.

Data confidence on this matchup is 75% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
